def stringConversion(X: str, Y: str) -> int:
    len_X = len(X)
    len_Y = len(Y)

    if len_Y > len_X:
        return 0

    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len_X and j < len_Y:
        if X[i].upper() == Y[j]:
            j += 1
        i += 1

    return 1 if j == len_Y else 0
